# DukaSmart

> DukaSmart helps Tanzanian SMEs improve operations through practical digital implementation, workflow automation, analytics, ongoing support, and focused software.

DukaSmart's current live software helps shop owners and staff record paid and credit sales, maintain quantity-based product stock, record supplier purchases, and review owner reports. The service is designed for phones, tablets, and computers. Other business systems, digital presence, integrations, and automation are project-based service areas and are not all built-in software modules.

## Services
- [SME digital operations services](https://dukasmart.online/services): Digital presence, system implementation, workflow automation, analytics, and ongoing support.
- [About DukaSmart](https://dukasmart.online/about): Service-first approach to improving SME operations and developing reusable software from repeated needs.
- [Contact DukaSmart](https://dukasmart.online/contact): WhatsApp support at +255616234063 or product feedback by email at support.dukasmart12@gmail.com.

## Product
- [Home](https://dukasmart.online/): Product overview and account signup.
- [Features](https://dukasmart.online/features): Overview of shop workflows.
- [Sales management](https://dukasmart.online/features/sales-management): Record sales and update stock.
- [Inventory management](https://dukasmart.online/features/inventory-management): Product quantities and low-stock thresholds.
- [Purchase management](https://dukasmart.online/features/purchase-management): Record received stock and purchase costs.
- [Credit sales](https://dukasmart.online/features/credit-sales): Record paid or credit status and optional customer details.
- [Business reports](https://dukasmart.online/features/business-reports): Daily and monthly summaries, including estimated gross product profit.

## Guides and tools
- [Knowledge hub](https://dukasmart.online/blog): Practical guides for small retailers.
- [Profit calculator](https://dukasmart.online/tools/profit-calculator): Estimates gross profit and gross margin; it does not calculate net profit.
- [Stock reorder calculator](https://dukasmart.online/tools/stock-calculator): Estimates a reorder point from average daily sales, lead time, and safety stock.

## Product limitations
DukaSmart is not a payment gateway or dedicated barcode POS terminal. It does not currently provide automated credit collection or reminders, offline operation, serial-number or warranty tracking, or expiry-date management. Reported profit is an estimate of gross product profit before operating expenses, taxes, and other costs.

The information above summarizes the public site and product as documented. Use the linked pages as the primary source for current details.
